sources.snippet: TensorRT Model Connect is an extensive collection of AI Model reference implementations in C++, on top of NVIDIA TensorRT. Model Connect is powered by an agentic workflow that continuously adds support for upcoming models, drastically reducing integration effort on user side and time until new models become compatible.
